subject.title: [Feature Request] Add option to disable 'new messages' notification banner in WebChat

question: Should WebChat retain a visible catch-up action in every auto-scroll mode, and if so should the requested preference hide only its banner presentation, replace it with a smaller control, or leave the current control unchanged?
rationale: The merged auto-scroll selector intentionally preserves this control as the recovery path when automatic following is disabled; source-level implementation cannot safely choose the accessibility and UX contract.

options.title: Add a compact persisted indicator mode
options.body: Keep a reachable manual catch-up action but let users select a less intrusive presentation in local WebChat settings.

options.title: Keep the current control
options.body: Treat the existing control as the required recovery affordance for readers who are away from the live tail.

options.title: Hide the control in an explicit mode
options.body: Allow suppression only after defining an alternative keyboard- and mobile-accessible route back to current output.

recommendation.title: Add a compact persisted indicator mode
recommendation.body: Keep a reachable manual catch-up action but let users select a less intrusive presentation in local WebChat settings.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged auto-scroll selector established the adjacent settings and recovery behavior that this decision would extend.
